title: BAI Elections Set for December 26 in Guwahati
indian_angle: The upcoming elections for the Badminton Association of India will determine the leadership for Indian badminton, with the event scheduled to take place in Guwahati.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced that its forthcoming elections will be held on December 26, 2026, in Guwahati, a key event for the sport's governance in the country.

title: Mini National Badminton Championships Venue Shifted to Raipur
indian_angle: The venue change for the Yonex-Sunrise 5th Mini National Badminton Championships to Raipur directly impacts young Indian players and local badminton communities.
summary: The Yonex-Sunrise 5th Mini National Badminton Championships 2026, originally scheduled elsewhere, will now be held in Raipur from November 24 to 27, 2026, as per a recent circular.

title: Senior National Badminton Championships Announced for Bhubaneswar
indian_angle: India's top senior badminton players will compete at the 79th Inter State – Inter Zonal & 88th Senior National Badminton Championships in Bhubaneswar, a premier domestic event.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has issued a circular announcing the Yonex-Sunrise 79th Inter State – Inter Zonal & 88th Senior National Badminton Championships 2026, to be held in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, from December 17 to 24, 2026.

title: Eligibility List Released for Sub-Junior Nationals in Bangalore
indian_angle: The eligibility list for the Sub-Junior National Badminton Championships in Bangalore is crucial for young Indian talents vying for national recognition in the U15 and U17 categories.
summary: The eligibility list for the Yonex-Sunrise 38th Sub-Junior National Badminton Championships 2026 (U15 & U17) has been released, with the event scheduled for Bangalore from November 30 to December 5, 2026.

title: BAI Forms New Athletes Committee to Boost Player Representation
indian_angle: The formation of the BAI Athletes Committee signifies a step towards greater player involvement and welfare within Indian badminton's administrative structure.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aimed at enhancing player representation and ensuring their voices are heard in key decisions.

title: National Coaching Camp for World Junior Championships in Guwahati
indian_angle: This national coaching camp in Guwahati is vital for preparing India's junior squad for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships, aiming for international success.
summary: A national coaching camp is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing Indian junior players for the forthcoming BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
